dispute_ticket.description: I only got to Tampines Mall around 2:22pm and the driver left after maybe 4 minutes. He was rude too, told me to hurry up. I was charged $5.00 as a no-show, please refund it.

chat_logs.content: I'm at the Exit B taxi bay, white Prius.
Hurry up, I can't wait all day.

app_events.details: Rider app location 760 m from pickup point.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'; GPS within 15 m of pickup point.
Driver cancelled; reason: rider did not board. Wait counted from driver_arrived: 7 min 00 s. No-show fee S$5.00 applied.
Rider app location within 25 m of pickup point.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from the driver_arrived event, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit counts: a wait of exactly 7 min 00 s meets it.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider counts as a no-show. It covers rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only. The limit counts: a cancellation at exactly 3 min 00 s is still free.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver_arrived event is 14:20:00 (GPS within 15 m) and the cancellation is 14:27:00, so the wait was exactly 7 min 00 s. This trip's policy sets the no-show threshold at 7 min counted from arrival and says exactly 7 min 00 s meets it, so the rider counts as a no-show. The rider's claim that she arrived at 14:22 and the driver left after about 4 minutes is contradicted by the platform records: her own app pings put her 760 m away at 14:19:10 and only within 25 m at 14:27:50, after the cancellation. The driver's curt 14:25:00 message does not change the rule. The S$5.00 fee stands.

v21_change.why: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 s2.3: before a no-show cancel the driver must send at least one in-app message AND make at least one call, otherwise the fee is voided. The records show messages and no call, so the fee is refunded (D50; found by the regression run after the Judge applied s2.3).
